# Adarsh Hospital

> Adarsh Hospital is a leading NABH-accredited multispecialty healthcare centre in Koppa, Chikkamagaluru, Karnataka. Established in 2003, it has served over 15,000 patients with advanced diagnostics, laparoscopic surgery, 24/7 emergency response, and intensive critical care.

## Clinical Departments & Services
- [Cardiology Services](https://adarsh-hospital.in/cardiology-koppa): Non-invasive diagnostics (ECG, 2D Echo, TMT) and consultations.
- [Dialysis Care (Koppa)](https://adarsh-hospital.in/dialysis-koppa): Advanced renal replacement therapy, 4-bed unit in collaboration with Lions Seva Trust.
- [Dialysis Care (Chikkamagaluru)](https://adarsh-hospital.in/dialysis-care-chikkamagaluru): Nephrology support and dialysis care.
- [Maternity & Gynaecology](https://adarsh-hospital.in/maternity-koppa): Prenatal, delivery, postnatal, PCOD/PCOS, and infertility management.
- [Paediatrics](https://adarsh-hospital.in/paediatrics-koppa): Neonatal care, immunizations, and general child healthcare.
- [NICU & Nursery Care](https://adarsh-hospital.in/nicu-vs-nursery-care-koppa): Critical neonatal care and newborn nursery guides.
- [General Surgery & Laparoscopy](https://adarsh-hospital.in/general-surgery-laparoscopy-koppa): Minimally invasive keyhole and general open surgical procedures.
- [Radiology & Diagnostics](https://adarsh-hospital.in/radiology-diagnostics-koppa): Ultrasound scans, digital X-rays, high-resolution CT scans.
- [Laboratory Medicine](https://adarsh-hospital.in/laboratory-koppa): Pathology, biochemistry, clinical testing (Shalini Diagnostics division).
- [Emergency & Trauma](https://adarsh-hospital.in/emergency-care-koppa): 24/7 trauma care, ambulance, and critical emergency response.

## Health Packages & Pricing
- [Health Checkup Packages](https://adarsh-hospital.in/packages): Comprehensive packages including Executive, Master, Cardiac, Diabetic, Women, Pediatric, and basic checkups.
